purpose: Determine whether an existing public system network dump provides default-network, validated/usable capability, and DNS fields beyond WifiDevice connected state.

bounded_lookup.limitation: Only the searched local, non-ignored receipt/document files; not a claim that no command exists elsewhere. Static API gap-map mentions are not successful service dump receipts.

existing_evidence.caveat: The original command filters WifiDevice output to state/status; it does not establish which other fields an unfiltered service dump supports.

request.executor: outer only; preparation is not execution
request.failure_policy: Preserve actual failure; no retry or alternative entry.

followup_rule: Select a service name/ID only from the actual returned inventory; request its existing help/dump syntax only when supported by that evidence. Do not guess a numeric service ID or assume -h support. Service listing alone does not prove the requested data fields exist.
decision: If discovery/help shows only already-known interface connection fields, no added information supports another launch. No launch or repair is requested here.
